subject.title: Session Routing Bugs: CLI routing to wrong session, WeChat ID inconsistency, and session deadlock from message flooding

question: How should maintainers split and scope this bundled session-routing report before implementation?
rationale: The source gaps are real, but the durable fix affects default TUI session policy, channel/plugin ownership, inter-session routing semantics, and whether background events should be isolated from user-facing sessions.

options.title: Split by routing surface
options.body: Track meaningful-activity ordering in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51028, create or use separate focused work for TUI default-session policy, WeChat identity routing, and background-event isolation, then close this umbrella only after the links are recorded.

options.title: Keep as one umbrella
options.body: Use this issue as the single manual product thread until owners decide all four behaviors, accepting that it is too broad for an autonomous fix lane.

options.title: Narrow to WeChat only
options.body: Treat the CLI and activity-ordering parts as separate and keep this issue only for a live WeChat identity/deadlock reproduction.

recommendation.title: Split by routing surface
recommendation.body: Track meaningful-activity ordering in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/51028, create or use separate focused work for TUI default-session policy, WeChat identity routing, and background-event isolation, then close this umbrella only after the links are recorded.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest sampled owner for current session-list/TUI session behavior and is already named in related session product-direction review context.
